findings.title: Reference adapter requests lose tool schemas and routing fields before witness comparison
findings.counterexample: Delivered tools=[]; alternatively a forged capability/schema, or model=wrong-model/sessionId=wrong-session/maxTokens=1. Both real native model calls and echo body complete; measureToolTurn accepts all three altered deliveries.
findings.fix: Capture the complete actual adapter request at entry before awaiting: all own data fields including tools/toolHistory/provider/model/maxTokens/sessionId and explicit signal presence/state. Validate actual tool availability/schema/routing against the fixture/registered capability; compare the complete captured data. Preserve request/header event differences; add independent missing/extra/changed request-schema and routing controls.

findings.title: CVG observation drops per-call ModelResult usage and provenance
findings.counterexample: Two delivered ModelResults changed from tokens (1,2)+(1,2) to (0,0)+(2,4); separately both provider/model values replaced by forged-provider/forged-model with an extra result field. Native engine consumes these values; text and aggregate usage remain unchanged, and both altered runs are accepted.
findings.fix: Capture immutable complete per-call returned ModelResult objects at the synthetic gateway boundary (not only text), alongside each request/call ordinal. Check native per-call usage/provenance and reconcile totals. Add compensating-usage and missing/extra/provenance tamper controls, without changing production orchestration.

findings.title: Epoch normalization accepts an impossible native timestamp
findings.counterexample: Set reference.native.events[0].time=9007199254740991. This is a safe integer but new Date(value).getTime() is NaN. Normalization erases it and measureToolTurn accepts.
findings.fix: Require a valid finite epoch representable by Date in addition to the existing nonnegative safe-integer requirement before normalization; reject out-of-range values. Keep ordinary valid enumerated clock differences permitted and retain all raw time bytes.

limitations: Fresh I1 independence requirement was not met: the initial read of docs/08_runtime/agent_coordination.md returned historical coordination entries, including prior-review outcomes and builder summaries. No separate ledger, .agent, .gauntlet, earlier review/report, history file, or other proof directory was subsequently opened. This report cannot serve as the requested uncontaminated fresh I1 acceptance; independently reproducible findings remain usable. No descendants were spawned; model/effort were inherited.

Scope is this candidate test-support only. SDK single_pass tool journey, SDK/ABI/session-lifecycle equivalence, full parity, source-to-lib correspondence and transitive artifact closure remain NOT_VERIFIED. Production contracts and global/T2 integration/unit/PG/E2E/coverage/certification/release gates are pending and not granted.

Pre/post integrity covers the sealed packet, 133 source/live pairs, nine actual exported artifacts and 11 explicitly needed extra source files. It does not claim full-worktree/node_modules/transitive closure or an OS-enforced continuous snapshot. Inherited tooling was accessed through a symlink; caches/output remained under review-r1.

Candidate-supplied types/lint command records report exit 0; these checks were not independently rerun. Own full-focus execution initially lacked SDK source files in the minimal copy, causing two suite-import errors; after copying and fingerprinting the needed live SDK files, explicit/default each passed 23 tests. Initial failure evidence is retained.

The first fault-injection attempt did not intercept the child and is not fault proof. Both its exit-0 runs are retained. Corrected native builtin interception produced real child exits 23 and runner exits 1 in both modes. Initial probe v1 included an out-of-API wrapper extra-field control and caller-evaluated getter; v2 corrected these controls and recorded zero getter executions.
independence: Requested fresh I1 invalidated by initial coordination-history exposure; no acceptance granted
